name: Multi-Agent Review shows the seeded three-agent run, and returning to it shows the same run plus Start New Review
description: AC-30 and AC-36, over the multi-agent run the seed writes for PR #482 (server/src/db/seed.ts, the L07 block). NO STEP STARTS A RUN: the hermetic stack has no provider key and e2e/CLAUDE.md forbids a step that could trigger a model, so the 'this PR has already been run' state is the SEEDED one — which is what AC-36 exists to make possible. From the app root, follow the home redirect to the seeded repo, reach the screen through the nav entry L07 adds to `vendor/ui/nav.ts` (GLOBAL group), pick PR #482, and assert the three seeded agent columns, a seeded finding title, a `did not flag` take in `Where agents disagree`, and the group badge that says three agents named the same place. Then press `Start New Review` — which re-opens the picker at zero selected and sends nothing — navigate away to the PR list, and come back: the same columns and the same run meta line return, and the meta line is the flow's proxy for 'zero new agent_runs' (it is computed from the three seeded durations and costs, so a fourth run would change it). Exercises nav.ts → the multi-agent route → useMultiAgentRun → GET /pulls/:id/multi-agent, which makes zero model calls by construction. Every asserted string is a seed literal or a message-file literal (client/messages/en/multiAgent.json, client/messages/en/runs.json). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack. One step uses the CLI's `select` command with a raw CSS selector: the PR control is a native <select>, and `find` has no `select` action (its actions are click, fill, check, hover, text). It is still deterministic — the page has exactly one <select> — but it is the one locator here outside the `find role|text|label` set.
